تستأجروا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْجِرُوا (tastaʔjirū) /tas.taʔ.d͡ʒi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# تُسْتَأْجَرُوا (tustaʔjarū) /tus.taʔ.d͡ʒa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
